section.content: The utility model discloses a biological gene test tube rack, which comprises a shell and a turntable frame, wherein a window is formed in one side of the shell along the vertical direction, the turntable frame is rotatably installed in the shell, a plurality of clamping grooves for placing test tubes are formed in the edge of the turntable frame, the clamping grooves expose out of the window along with the rotation of the turntable frame, an elastic sleeve is arranged in the clamping grooves, and a notch is formed in the edge of the elastic sleeve; by arranging the turntable frame for placing the test tubes in a shell, the clamping groove on the turntable frame can be exposed out of the window on the shell along with the rotation of the turntable frame so as to place the test tubes on the clamping groove; after the test tube rack is placed, the placed test tube can be stored in the shell through rotating the turntable rack, and compared with an open test tube rack, the test tube rack can effectively protect the test tube and reduce the possibility of damage to the test tube due to collision; meanwhile, the corresponding elastic sleeve is arranged in the clamping groove, and can be tightly attached to the peripheral wall of the test tube when the test tube is put in, so that the test tube is more stable and firm.

本实用新型公开了一种生物基因试管架，包括壳体及转盘架，所述壳体的一侧沿竖直方向开设有一窗口，所述转盘架转动安装于所述壳体内，所述转盘架的边缘开设有多个用于放置试管的卡槽，所述卡槽随所述转盘架的转动露出所述窗口，所述卡槽内设置有弹性套，所述弹性套的边缘具有一缺口；通过将用于放置试管的转盘架设置在一壳体内，转盘架上的卡槽可随转盘架的转动露出壳体上的窗口，以便在卡槽上放置试管；放置完毕后通过转动转盘架可将放置的试管收纳入壳体内部，与开放式试管架相比，其能够有效保护试管，减少试管受到碰撞而受损的可能性；同时卡槽中安装相应的弹性套，在试管放入时该弹性套可紧密贴合在试管的外周壁上，使其更加稳固和牢靠。

Biological gene test tube rackTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the field of test tube racks, in particular to a biological gene test tube rack.

Background

The gene test tube rack is a special device for supporting test tubes and is widely applied to biology and biotechnology laboratories. In molecular biology and genetics experiments, test tubes are often used for storing and transporting biological samples, and test tube racks are used for maintaining stability and safety of the test tubes so as to avoid leakage or damage of the biological samples.

The shape and size of the gene test tube rack have also been improved many times. Early gene test tube racks were typically long, thin, cylindrical in shape for tube placement. Modern gene test tube racks typically have a plurality of holes that can accommodate a plurality of test tubes or culture dishes. In addition, some gene test tube racks also have heating and cooling functions, so that more stable temperature control can be provided for experiments.

However, the conventional test tube rack has some problems. For example, there is a certain gap between the test tube and the slot of the test tube rack, resulting in insufficient stability after the test tube is put in. Meanwhile, the existing test tube rack mostly adopts an open design, when the test tube is collided or moved, the test tube is easy to slide or drop, and damage is caused to the test tube and a sample.

Therefore, how to solve the above-mentioned drawbacks of the prior art is the subject of the present utility model.

Disclosure of Invention

In order to solve the problems, the utility model discloses a biological gene test tube rack.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the present utility model provides the following technical solutions: the utility model provides a biological gene test-tube rack, includes casing and carousel frame, a window has been seted up along vertical direction to one side of casing, carousel frame rotate install in the casing, a plurality of draw-in grooves that are used for placing the test tube have been seted up at the edge of carousel frame, the draw-in groove is followed the rotation of carousel frame exposes the window, be provided with the elastic sleeve in the draw-in groove, the edge of elastic sleeve has a breach, the breach is located the outside of draw-in groove, so that the test tube can by the breach card is gone into in the elastic sleeve.

In the above scheme, the inner side of the elastic sleeve extends downwards to form an extending edge, and the inner peripheral surface of the extending edge is tapered from top to bottom.

In the above scheme, at least two elastic sleeves are arranged in each clamping groove, and the two elastic sleeves are respectively positioned at the top end and the bottom end of the clamping groove.

In the above scheme, the carousel frame is provided with a plurality of, and a plurality of carousel frames are along vertical direction interval arrangement in the casing.

In the above scheme, a plurality of the carousel frame is all rotated and is installed in one is located in the pivot of casing, just the carousel frame is through sliding adjustment mechanism follow pivot adjustment position.

In the above scheme, the sliding adjusting mechanism comprises a sleeve sleeved on the rotating shaft in a sliding manner and an adjusting bolt screwed into the sleeve through threads, and the threaded end of the adjusting bolt penetrates through the sleeve and abuts against the rotating shaft.

In the scheme, a plurality of sliding sleeves are sleeved on the shell from top to bottom in a separable manner, and the part of the turntable frame exposed out of the window is shielded by the sliding sleeves.

The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows:

1. according to the scheme, the turntable frame for placing the test tubes is arranged in the shell, and the clamping groove on the turntable frame can be exposed out of the window on the shell along with the rotation of the turntable frame so as to place the test tubes on the clamping groove; after the test tube rack is placed, the placed test tube can be stored in the shell through rotating the turntable rack, and compared with an open test tube rack, the test tube rack can effectively protect the test tube and reduce the possibility of damage to the test tube due to collision;

2. through installing corresponding elastic sleeve in the draw-in groove that is used for placing the test tube, this elastic sleeve can closely laminate on the periphery wall of test tube when the test tube is put into, makes it more firm and firm.

Detailed Description

The present utility model is further illustrated in the following drawings and detailed description, which are to be understood as being merely illustrative of the utility model and not limiting the scope of the utility model.

Examples: referring to fig. 1-4, a bio-gene test tube rack is mainly used for placing test tubes containing bio-gene samples, and comprises a housing 100 and a turntable frame 200, wherein a window 101 is formed in one side of the housing 100 along the vertical direction, the turntable frame 200 is rotatably installed in the housing 100, a plurality of clamping grooves 201 for placing the test tubes are formed in the edge of the turntable frame 200, the clamping grooves 201 expose the window 101 along with the rotation of the turntable frame 200 so as to place the test tubes, and the placed test tubes can be stored into the housing 100 by rotating the turntable frame after the placement is completed.

An elastic sleeve 202 is arranged in the clamping groove 201, a notch 203 is formed in the edge of the elastic sleeve 202, and the notch 203 is positioned on the outer side of the clamping groove 201, so that a test tube can be clamped into the elastic sleeve 202 through the notch 203; wherein, draw-in groove 201 is the sealed open slot in open top bottom, and when placing the test tube, test tube bottom can support the test tube by leaning on the bottom of draw-in groove 201, and elastic material such as rubber or silica gel can be used to the elastic sleeve 202 specifically, and its bore is less than test tube diameter, and when the test tube card, the inner peripheral wall of elastic sleeve 202 can closely support to press on the periphery wall of test tube, makes it more firm.

In order to further improve the stability of placing the test tube and reduce the risk of falling off the test tube, the inner side of the elastic sleeve 202 downwards extends to form an extension edge 204, the inner peripheral surface of the extension edge 204 is gradually reduced from top to bottom, and after the test tube is clamped into the clamping groove 201, the caliber of the lower edge of the extension edge 204 is smaller, so that the test tube can be firmly pressed on the test tube, the friction force between the elastic sleeve 202 and the outer wall of the test tube is further increased, and falling off of the test tube is avoided.

In addition, at least two elastic sleeves 202 can be arranged in each clamping groove 201, and the two elastic sleeves 202 are respectively positioned at the top end and the bottom end of the clamping groove 201, so that when a test tube is placed, the upper end and the lower end of the test tube can be clamped and fixed at the same time, and the possibility of shaking is reduced.

In order to increase the storage capacity of the test tube rack, the carousel rack 200 may be provided in plurality, and the plurality of carousel racks 200 are arranged in the housing 100 at intervals in the vertical direction.

Simultaneously, a plurality of turntable frames 200 are rotatably installed on a rotating shaft positioned in the shell 100, and the turntable frames 200 are adjusted in position along the rotating shaft through a sliding adjusting mechanism; wherein, slip regulating mechanism locates epaxial sleeve and screws in telescopic adjusting bolt through the screw thread including the slip cap, and adjusting bolt's screw thread end passes the sleeve and supports and lean on in the pivot, and this adjusting bolt can be provided with a plurality ofly to improve its stability of tightness adjustment with the pivot, make the interval between two adjacent carousel frames 200 adjustable through slip regulating mechanism's setting, with the demand of placing of the test tube of adaptation different length.

After placing the test tube, a sliding sleeve 300 can be sleeved on the shell 100 from top to bottom, and the part of the turntable frame 200 exposing the window 101 is shielded by the sliding sleeve 300, so that the test tube exposed by the window 101 is avoided, and the overall protective performance of the test tube is improved. The sliding sleeve 300 may be provided in plurality according to the number of the turret frame 200.

As can be seen from the above-mentioned scheme, the turntable rack 200 for placing test tubes is disposed in a housing 100, and the clamping groove 201 on the turntable rack 200 can be exposed out of the window 101 on the housing 100 along with the rotation of the turntable rack 200, so as to place test tubes on the clamping groove 201; after the test tube rack is placed, the placed test tube can be stored into the shell 100 through rotating the turntable rack, and compared with an open test tube rack, the test tube rack can effectively protect the test tube, and the possibility that the test tube is damaged due to collision is reduced. Meanwhile, a corresponding elastic sleeve 202 is arranged in the clamping groove 201 for placing the test tube, and the elastic sleeve 202 can be tightly attached to the peripheral wall of the test tube when the test tube is placed in, so that the test tube is more stable and firm.

It should be noted that the foregoing merely illustrates the technical idea of the present utility model and is not intended to limit the scope of the present utility model, and that a person skilled in the art may make several improvements and modifications without departing from the principles of the present utility model, which fall within the scope of the claims of the present utility model.
